translations.web: I said, “Should a man like me flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”
translations.bsb: But I replied, “Should a man like me run away? Should one like me go into the temple to save his own life? I will not go!”
translations.kjv: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.
translations.asv: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.
